text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — spike in 5xx errors on api.redwood.internal /v1/generate (gateway-east). 3m window: baseline 0.5% -> 13%. Paging #oncall.

maya: I’m on it, paged and joining. can someone check if a recent route change went out to gateway-east?

liam: I saw a canary earlier for route weight adjustments to model-pool-a -> model-pool-b at 11:03 (30% -> 70%). Not sure if that touched gateway rules.

anya: I rolled out a traffic-weight tweak last night for the ev-frontend but didn’t touch gateway LB config. pinging infra to confirm.

sam: oncall here. maya, can you confirm customer impact? Any external 5xx seen by hosted API customers or internal-only?

maya: Customer-facing: error-rate signal on prod/public-api dashboards — upstream 502/504 surge. Some customers reported timeouts in app telemetry. We should treat as P1 until mitigated.

carol: I’m seeing increased Envoy 5xx logs pointing to upstream code 503 responses from runtime pods. Also note high retry counts in the Envoy stats: cluster: model-pool-b, retry_overflow increased.

liam: pulling envoy config snapshot now.

liam: config diff (recent):
```
route: 
  - prefix: /v1/generate
    cluster: round_robin(model-pool-b)
    retry_policy:
      retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure,reset"
      num_retries: 3
    per_try_timeout: 1s
    retry_back_off:
      base_interval: 0.2s
      max_interval: 0.8s
```
This was added during the canary. Previously we had num_retries: 1 and per_try_timeout: 500ms.

maya: retries x3 + 1s per-try timeout with backoff could be amplifying load when upstream is unhealthy -> retry storm. Also circuit breaker default for model-pool-b is low (max_connections: 500). With retries, we may be exhausting upstream connections.

sam: mitigation options: 1) rollback the retry policy to previous values 2) temporarily set num_retries=0 at gateway 3) reduce route weight to divert traffic away from model-pool-b 4) bump circuit breaker limits. Which is fastest?

anya: fastest is num_retries=0 on gateway — single config toggle. Second is weight shift. Rolling forward circuit breaker change requires pod restart for JVM runtime — slower.

maya: I will disable retries on the gateway route and reduce per_try_timeout to 300ms as a precaution. will also request immediate weight shift if 5xx persists.

liam: I can push a hotfix to envoy config now. Applying patch to gateway-east: set num_retries: 0 and remove per_try_timeout override.

deploy-bot: deploy started for gateway-east/config-hotfix by liam (change_id: cfg-1795)

maya: Applying config...

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded (gateway-east) — cfg-1795.

maya: Monitoring metrics now.

carol: Within 40s, 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 1.8%. Connection saturation on model-pool-b decreased. Still some tail errors from slow backends.

sam: Customer impact reduced. Not seeing new customer error reports in the last 3 minutes. Good.

liam: To be safe, I’m doing a gradual weight shift: model-pool-b 70% -> 40% over 30s, model-pool-a 30% -> 60%.

deploy-bot: route-weight rollout started by liam (rollout-id: r-880).

maya: After weight shift, 5xx stabilized at 0.6% — close to baseline. Latency slightly up for some requests but within SLO.

anya: Root cause hypothesis: aggressive retry policy combined with an upstream instance group in model-pool-b that had a transient degradation (GC pauses / slow responses). Retries amplified load, hit circuit breaker thresholds and caused cascading 5xx.

carol: logs show a subset of pods with repeated 5xx and high GC pause durations around the timeframe of the canary. I’ll open a pod-level investigation in eng-runtime.

maya: Action items: 
- (maya) Keep gateway retries disabled for 1h and monitor.
- (liam) Run healthcheck/heapdump on flagged runtime pods and correlate with GC logs.
- (anya) Add safety: implement a traffic-shaping rule to prefer model-pool-a when retry counts exceed X.
- (carol) Start a postmortem doc with timeline and config diffs.

sam: I’ll notify support (ops-alert) and affected customer success owners with the current mitigation and ETA for full root cause.

maya: Marking incident as mitigated but still under investigation. Will convert to follow-up ticket for eng-runtime and change control review for retry defaults. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident duration so far: ~14m.

liam: quick note — please avoid rolling retry policy changes during business hours without canarying in dev cluster first. We should add a guard in the deploy pipeline to warn on increases to num_retries > 1.

anya: Agreed. Adding that to infra backlog and will propose a deploy-blocker rule.

carol: Postmortem owner assigned: carol. PM/SE brief scheduled in 2h.

sam: closing pager for now — will reopen if errors recur. Great work team. :tada:
